existing_group_assignments.rationale: Reduced fetal/adult testosterone is the same decreased-testosterone endpoint, specified by life stage, alongside the existing synthesis and circulating-level events.
Airway inflammation is increased inflammation specific to the airway, matching the existing general and tissue-specific inflammation events.
Decreased neural progenitor cell adhesion to laminin concerns laminin binding, but it is a distinct process from the existing laminin events.

new_groups.rationale: Both describe decreased myelin basic protein expression, one general and the other specific to oligodendrocytes.
Increased or abnormal remodeling in different tissues (cardiac, vascular, neural).
